shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "cat package.json && echo '--- index.html ---' && cat index.html && echo '--- src/main.tsx ---' && cat src/main.tsx && echo '--- src/App.tsx ---' && cat src/App.tsx && echo '--- tsconfig ---' && cat tsconfig.json && echo '--- vite ---' && cat vite.config.ts && echo '--- vite-env ---' && cat src/vite-env.d.ts"

/bin/bash -c "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -120 && echo '--- configure dts ---' && rg -n \"configure|Lang|I18n|lang\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -80"

/bin/bash -c "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts && echo '--- configure.js ---' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.js && echo '--- useLang.js ---' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useLang.js && echo '--- ThemeProvider.js ---' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js"

/bin/bash -c "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo '--- index ---'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo '--- files ---'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup -maxdepth 2 -type f -name '*.d.ts' -print"

/bin/bash -c "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/i18n.js && echo '--- Breadcrumbs i18n keys ---' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Breadcrumbs/i18n/en.js && echo '--- ru ---' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Breadcrumbs/i18n/ru.js && echo '--- Select en/ru keys ---' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/i18n/en.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/i18n/ru.js"

/bin/bash -c 'for c in Alert ActionsPanel Accordion AvatarStack UserLabel Dialog; do echo "=== $c ==="; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/$c/i18n -name '"'*.json' -maxdepth 1 -exec sh -c 'echo \"-- "'$1"; cat "$1"'"' _ {} \\;; done"
